items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: When I went to Mandeville to play with Buddy, and Fritz came up on the bandstand, we tuned up and everything, and we'll start the playing

ctx.x: No, I'm pretty sure he's dead. I never did. George Lewis said he was dead. I'm sure he must have known him.

When I went to Mandeville to play with Buddy, and Fritz came up on the bandstand, we tuned up and everything, and we'll start the playing, and that man played more clarinet than any man that I ever heard. Really? Never heard. That's right.
I think George Lewis says that, too. He said he's the greatest...
